brief.subject: IRS sets hearing on Trump account investment rules
brief.headline: IRS Moves Toward a Hearing on Trump Account Investment Rules
brief.dek: A Federal Register notice ties a hearing to proposed rules on Trump account investments, and the IRS posts online Tax Forum seminars.
brief.lede: The IRS has issued a Federal Register notice tied to a hearing on its proposed rules for Trump account investments. Advisers fielding client questions should track how the guidance develops.

sections.heading: Trump Account Rules Head to Hearing
bullets: A Federal Register notice dated 2026-11-04 concerns a hearing on proposed Trump account investment rules.
The underlying proposal (CC- 00349938-26) first appeared in the Federal Register on August 21, 2026.
Only eligible investments may be held before the beginning of the calendar year in which the beneficiary turns 18.
This is still a proposal, so final investment limits could change before the rules take effect.

sections.heading: IRS Tax Forum Seminars Go Online
bullets: The IRS has launched its 2026 Nationwide Tax Forum Online for tax professionals.
More than a dozen seminars recorded at this year's in-person forum are included.
Tax pros can earn continuing education credits remotely, which matters for credential upkeep.

brief.seo_description: IRS notice ties a hearing to proposed Trump account investment rules, and the 2026 Nationwide Tax Forum seminars go online with CE credits.

items.title: Proposed Rule: Guidance on Eligible Investments for Trump Accounts; Hearing
items.snippet: This document provides a notice of proposed rulemaking (CC- 00349938-26) published in the Federal Register on August 21, 2026. The proposed regulations provided guidance regarding eligible investments, which are the only assets in which the Trump account may be invested before the first day of the calendar year in which the account beneficiary attains 18.
